title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 48
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 48: the portions of the tribes, the holy offering, the city with its gates, and its new name.

questions.text: Which tribe receives the first portion, counted from the north end?
questions.explanation: The names of the tribes begin from the north end, beside the way of Hethlon, and Dan has one portion there.

questions.text: Whose portion lies by the border of Dan?
questions.explanation: By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher has one portion.

questions.text: What is to be in the middle of the offering that lies by the border of Judah?
questions.explanation: By the border of Judah is the offering, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and the sanctuary is to be in the middle of it.

questions.text: The holy offering is to be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of whom?
questions.explanation: The holy offering is for the priests, the sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who kept God's instruction and did not go astray.

questions.text: What may the Levites not do with their portion of the land?
questions.explanation: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to Yahweh.

answers.text: Walk on it on holy days

questions.text: What is the five thousand that is left in the width to be used for?
questions.explanation: The five thousand left over in the width is for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands, and the city is to be in the middle of it.

answers.text: For the priests alone, as a most holy thing
For the prince alone, as his possession
For the sanctuary and its courts
For common use, for the city, for dwelling and pasture

questions.text: Who is to eat the increase of the land alongside the holy offering?
questions.explanation: The increase of that remainder is to be food for those who labor in the city, and those who labor in the city are to cultivate it.

answers.text: The priests of the sons of Zadok
Those who labor in the city
The aliens living in the land

questions.text: Who receives the remainder on either side of the holy offering and the possession of the city?
questions.explanation: The remainder on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city is to be for the prince.

answers.text: Those who labor in the city

questions.text: Which three gates are on the north side of the city?
questions.explanation: The gates of the city are named after the tribes of Israel, and the three gates northward are the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah, and the gate of Levi.

questions.text: What will the name of the city be from that day?
questions.explanation: The city will be eighteen thousand reeds around, and its name from that day will be, 'Yahweh is there.'
